gbm_population_evidence.quote: Phase I trials select pathologically confirmed recurrent central nervous system tumors (including but not limited to anaplastic astrocytoma, anaplastic oligoastrocytoma, glioblastoma, gliosarcoma, anaplastic ependymoma, Medulloblastoma, malignant meningioma, melanoma, etc.) postoperative patients
Phase IIa trial selects postoperative patients with pathologically confirmed recurrent glioblastoma

coder_notes: Oncolytic virus only -> excluded_intervention_type. Phase I enrols multiple recurrent CNS tumour types (gliomas, medulloblastoma, meningioma, melanoma) with glioblastoma named in inclusion; Phase IIa is GBM only. Coded basket_gbm_eligible (multi-tumour); mixed_glioma_gbm_named is the alternative, both are includes at S5. Biodistribution/viral shedding and anti-HSV2 antibodies relate to the virus, not a pharmacological candidate.
